title: Implement Trie / Prefix Search
contract: For each prefix query, report whether any lowercase dictionary word starts with it. Empty prefix matches only a nonempty dictionary.
brute: List<Boolean> out=new ArrayList<>();for(String query:queries){boolean found=false;for(String word:words){emit("Compare prefix against a dictionary word","query",query,"word",word);if(word.startsWith(query)){found=true;break;}}out.add(found);}return out;
optimal:
Trie root=new Trie();for(String word:words){Trie node=root;for(char c:word.toCharArray()){int i=c-'a';if(node.children[i]==null)node.children[i]=new Trie();node=node.children[i];}node.word=true;emit("Insert one shared-prefix path","word",word);}
List<Boolean> out=new ArrayList<>();for(String query:queries){Trie node=root;for(char c:query.toCharArray()){node=node.children[c-'a'];emit("Follow a character edge","query",query,"character",c);if(node==null)break;}out.add(words.length>0&&node!=null);}return out;
reasoning: Scan every dictionary word for each query.
A trie shares common prefixes; insert creates missing character edges and marks complete words.
For startsWith, arriving at any node is enough. Exact search additionally requires the word marker. The 26-way representation assumes lowercase English characters.
complexity: O(total characters + query characters), O(total characters) nodes
